verses.1: On that day, you will say: I give you thanks, O LORD; though you have been angry with me, your anger has abated, and you have consoled me.
verses.2: God indeed is my savior; I am confident and unafraid. My strength and my courage is the LORD, and he has been my savior.
verses.3: With joy you will draw water at the fountain of salvation,
verses.4: and say on that day: Give thanks to the LORD, acclaim his name; among the nations make known his deeds, proclaim how exalted is his name.
verses.5: Sing praise to the LORD for his glorious achievement; let this be known throughout all the earth.
verses.6: Shout with exultation, O city of Zion, for great in your midst is the Holy One of Israel!

notes.text: Israel's thanksgiving to the Lord, expressed in language like that of the Psalms.
